title: Lower density code governs the boundary wall between differently coded sites
text: Table 3.4c note: Where the subject site is adjacent to a site with a lower density code, the maximum wall length and height of the boundary wall between them is determined by the lower density code.

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Table 3.4c note. Needs the adjoining lot's coding per boundary; no per-boundary fact exists, so recorded as judgment. A planner re-runs the C3.4.4 rules with the lower code where it applies.
